params.name: organization-id
params.description: The unique identifier for the Upwind organization.

params.name: fingerprint
params.description: The unique fingerprint of a scanned image, computed by Upwind from the image digest and image name. It identifies a scanned image (not an individual scan execution) and cannot be calculated on the client side. Obtain it from the `fingerprint` field of the objects returned by the [search shift-left events](/restapi/v2/search-shift-left-events) endpoint.

items.docs: A `GET` request sent to the endpoint root followed by the fingerprint name returns detailed information about a specific ShiftLeft scan.
